style: Style: dark navy background (#0b1b2b), teal (#4ecdc4) and amber (#f4b942) accents, white labels, flat vector icons, generous spacing, clean sans-serif lettering, landscape 16:9. Draw only the labels given here. No other text.

images.prompt: Concept slide titled "Two worlds, one stack". Left half labelled "AUTONOMY" with four icons and labels: "swarms", "consensus", "self-learning", "memory". Right half labelled "TRUST" with two icons and labels: "a written mandate per agent", "memory with history the host cannot read". The halves overlap in the middle in a lens shape labelled "the intersection".

Layered architecture diagram titled "rUv's stack, in five layers". Five horizontal layers stacked bottom to top, each a wide rounded bar with one short label on the left and a one-line description on the right: bottom "RVM" - "bare-metal capability VM, 7 rights, witness log"; "RuVector" - "memory substrate: vectors, graph, temporal"; "Ruflo" - "swarm orchestration: queens, workers, consensus, SPARC"; "MetaHarness" - "harness factory: agents, skills, governance policy"; top "Hosts" - "Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Actions, browser". Small flat icons per layer.

Hub-and-spoke diagram titled "Where sgit.ai plugs in". Centre: two stacked hexagons labelled "ABP: the mandate" and "sgit vault: encrypted history". Five spokes to boxes around the edge with the arrow label on each spoke: to "Ruflo policy engine" labelled "compiled rules + receipts"; to "RVM capabilities" labelled "token rights"; to "MetaHarness governance" labelled "policy as document"; to "RuVector memory" labelled "encrypted snapshots, branch per agent"; to "Claude Code session" labelled "session records".

Explainer card titled "One ABP row". A single wide card showing the capability "send.message.world" in monospace at the top, then five labelled fields in a row with small icons: "REACH: can it? yes", "MANDATE: may it? no", "GAP: reach without mandate", "BARRIER: policy deny + no mail credential", "OWNER: signed, valid until a date". Below, one small line: "grammar: verb . object . reach".

Process flow titled "POC1: the mandate becomes enforced policy". Left to right in five steps connected by arrows: "ABP (JSON)" -> "compile" -> "Ruflo policy engine" -> a split into two parallel lanes: top lane "legacy mode: everything allowed" in amber, bottom lane "enforce mode: allow / deny / approval" in teal -> "hash-chained receipts" -> a padlock labelled "sgit vault".

Process flow titled "POC2: agent memory with history". Two agent icons on the left labelled "coder" and "tester", each with an arrow to its own branch line labelled "branch per role"; the branches merge into a line labelled "main" inside a vault shape with a padlock labelled "server sees ciphertext only". On the right, a fresh server icon labelled "fresh runner" with an arrow from the vault labelled "clone + restore" and a check mark labelled "same answer".

Concept illustration titled "POC4: ask the policy, in the browser". A browser window with a search box containing "can the coder send email?" and below it an answer card with a red cross and the words "no - barrier: policy deny". A small badge in the corner reads "RuVector WASM" and a padlock badge reads "served from a vault". Works offline icon.

Grid of six tiles titled "Use cases". Each tile has one flat icon and one short label: "Govern a swarm", "Remember across runs", "Prove what happened", "Publish only on approval", "Learn with rollback", "Run anywhere: CI, browser, Claude Code".

Step-by-step strip titled "Replicate it in six steps". Six numbered circles connected by a line, each with an icon and a label: 1 "clone the repo", 2 "npm install", 3 "pip install sgit-ai", 4 "run the POCs", 5 "create two vaults", 6 "publish and serve".

Diagram titled "POC3: rights compiled from the mandate". Left: a document icon labelled "ABP rows for coder". Arrow labelled "compile" to the right: a capability token shaped like a key card with three lit chips "READ", "WRITE", "EXECUTE" and four dimmed chips "GRANT", "REVOKE", "PROVE", "GRANT_ONCE" under the heading "withheld". Footnote line: "the token says what; the ABP keeps why".

Comparison table titled "Agent memory: alone vs in a vault". Two columns headed "RuVector alone" and "RuVector + sgit vault". Five rows with a cross or a tick icon: "encryption at rest" cross / tick; "versioned history" cross / tick; "branch and merge per agent" cross / tick; "clone to another machine" cross / tick; "authorization boundary" partial / tick with the word "ABP".

Pipeline diagram titled "CI: the policy is a test". A row of stages connected by arrows: "build" -> "ABP gate" (shield icon) -> "POC1" -> "POC3" -> "POC4 build" -> a person icon labelled "human approval" -> a padlock labelled "publish to vault". Below, a second row: "POC2 write: coder" -> "POC2 write: tester" -> "POC2 read on a fresh runner".
